name: RomSeek
description: Sonarr-style game search and library for RomM, using Prowlarr and qBittorrent.

paths.name: State
paths.description: RomSeek's state (history, settings, the game list cache).

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Your MOS storage (/DATA), at /data as upstream mounts it, so qBittorrent's download paths and RomM's library line up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: RomSeek web app, published on host as 6721

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PROWLARR_URL
variables.description: Required. Your Prowlarr's address, like http://192.168.1.20:9696 (replace CHANGEME-IP with your server IP).

variables.name: PROWLARR_KEY
variables.description: Required. Prowlarr's API key (Settings, General, API Key).

variables.name: QBIT_URL
variables.description: Required. qBittorrent's web UI address, like http://192.168.1.20:8080. RomSeek has no qBittorrent login: in qBittorrent, Options, WebUI, turn on "Bypass authentication for clients in whitelisted IP subnets" and add your Docker network (like 172.16.0.0/12).

variables.name: QBIT_SAVE_PATH
variables.description: Where qBittorrent saves RomSeek's downloads, as both see it. Your MOS /DATA is /data here: add the volume /DATA at /data to qBittorrent too, so both use the same path.

variables.name: ROMM_URL
variables.description: Required. Your RomM's address, like http://192.168.1.20:8080.

variables.name: ROMM_LIBRARY
variables.description: RomM's roms folder as RomSeek sees it (/DATA is /data here), like /data/AppData/romm/library/roms. Finished games are moved here.
